name: Mail relay
description: Email for every app on this server through one Amazon SES, SendGrid or SMTP account. Each bound app gets SMTP_URL with its own token, never the account's login; mail goes out only from your domains, with a limit per app.

env.desc: ses, sendgrid, or smtp for any other relay
Domains apps may send from, like example.com (subdomains too)
SES: the SMTP username from the SES console (not an access key)
SES: the SMTP password from the SES console
SendGrid: an API key with Mail Send
smtp: the relay's host, like smtp.fastmail.com (port 587 unless you add one)
Recipients one app may send to an hour

email.desc: sends through Amazon SES, SendGrid or an SMTP relay
